title: WP900 G9 semantic-content crossover must exclude inter-trial carryover and hidden-state hysteresis
target: F2-WP-900 generation 9 semantic content causality crossover

material_observation.g9_strength: The active G9 claim correctly requires same-mechanism content crossover, condition-blind downstream semantic observation, counterbalanced order and repeated-content stability.
material_observation.remaining_confound: Counterbalancing and repeated-content stability do not by themselves exclude stateful carryover. If recipient, executor, cache, recurrent workspace, hidden model/session state, memoized payload lookup or any other mutable runtime state survives from trial n into trial n+1, the later outcome can depend on the previous payload while still appearing stably associated with the current payload under a deterministic four-trial schedule.
material_observation.scope_risk: A stable A/B crossover under shared mutable runtime state supports a history-conditioned treatment effect candidate, not an isolated current-broadcast semantic-content causal effect.

falsifier_hypothesis: G9 is causally underidentified unless every admitted trial either starts from an independently verified equivalent runtime pre-state or explicitly models and falsifies previous-trial influence. A canonical pre_state_sha256 that omits hidden/process/cache/workspace state is insufficient.
counterhypothesis: Counterbalanced order plus same-content repeats are enough to cancel carryover. This is false for deterministic hysteresis, asymmetric adaptation, caches or previous-payload dependent state machines where order effects can survive balancing or mimic content-specific stability.

executable_counterexample.state_machine: On receiving payload A, set hidden flag H=A; on payload B, set H=B. Emit current canonical outcome from previous H before updating H. With suitable initial state and a fixed ABBA/BAAB schedule, downstream outcomes can look repeatable and treatment-associated while being caused by prior-trial state rather than the current broadcast semantics.

trial_isolation: For each trial, prove a fresh recipient/executor process or a cryptographically bound reset/restore from the same admitted runtime snapshot before broadcast delivery.

Bind actual runtime pre-state, not only canonical database/task state: include recipient process/session identity, mutable cache/workspace identity, model/session state identity where applicable, and reset/restore receipt.
Fail closed if any treatment-relevant mutable state survives across trials without an explicit measured carryover model.
history_controls: Execute current-payload A after prior A and after prior B from otherwise equivalent reset checkpoints; require the same canonical semantic outcome.
Execute current-payload B after prior A and after prior B from otherwise equivalent reset checkpoints; require the same canonical semantic outcome.
Include a no-payload or neutral predecessor where the mechanism permits it, without changing the current-trial delivery/uptake/reentry path.
Randomize or counterbalance across multiple independently reset blocks; do not rely on one four-trial sequence.
blindness_and_lineage: The downstream outcome observer must receive neither current treatment label nor previous-treatment label nor expected outcome.
Bind current payload lineage, previous-trial lineage, reset/snapshot identity, DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY witness, task input, pre-state, recipient/executor identity and canonical outcome per trial.
If previous-treatment history changes the current outcome, classify history-conditioned/carryover causality rather than isolated semantic-content causality.

hard_negatives: same current payload + different previous payload yields different canonical outcome -> CARRYOVER_PRESENT
same nominal pre_state_sha256 but different recipient/session/cache identity -> PRESTATE_SCOPE_INCOMPLETE
reset command succeeds without independent post-reset readback -> RESET_EVIDENCE_INVALID
trial process is reused and hidden mutable state is not measured -> UNKNOWN_NOT_SEMANTIC_CAUSAL
order-balanced aggregate passes while per-history strata disagree -> AGGREGATION_HIDES_HYSTERESIS
promotion_rule: G9 may earn only the narrowest content/history-conditioned candidate supported by its executed evidence. Isolated semantic-content causal promotion requires either per-trial independently verified equivalent runtime state or executed history-stratified invariance showing that previous treatment does not change the current-payload outcome.
next_exact_action: Do not duplicate or mutate G9 from this reviewer lane. The active G9 owner should either (a) add per-trial fresh/reset-bound runtime-state proof plus history-stratified hard negatives before semantic-content promotion, or (b) preserve G9 as a narrower payload/history-conditioned causal candidate and defer isolated semantic-content causal credit to a successor executable discriminator.
